use vstd::prelude::*;

verus! {

pub trait One {
    fn one(&self) -> (r: u32)
        ensures
            r == 1,
    ;
}

pub struct S;

pub fn use_it<T: One>(s: &T) -> (r: u32)
    ensures
        r == 1,
{
    s.one()
}

} // verus!

macro_rules! mark {
    ($a:ident) => {
        #[verifier::$a]
        impl One for S {
            fn one(&self) -> u32 {
                6
            }
        }
    };
}

mark!(external); // disciplines:allow-trusted (spike e)
